lines.en: I float forward above the ground.

lines.zh: 我的火舌一路拖在身后
lines.en: My flames trail behind me.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，也不留下脚印
lines.en: I have no feet and leave no prints.
I drift in circles.
The air heats as I approach.
I pass over a brazier.

lines.zh: 我的裙摆一样的火在摆
lines.en: My skirt of flame sways.
I drift out of the pillar's shadow.
I glide slowly to the other side.
My edges never stop burning.
I pause in midair.
I float past a torch.
I hover there, burning slowly.
The flames make no sound.
I have no need to breathe.
My shape keeps changing.
I wait for a summoner.

lines.zh: 我身上的火是冷的边缘，热的中心
lines.en: My fire is cool at the edge, hot at the core.
I drift gently.
Sparks fall at my feet.
This place does not interest me.
I flare, then dim.
I stand out in this stone room.
I only hover, watching who moves first.
My fire plays on the walls.
The heat has cracked the stones.
I burn quietly.
I listen for an incantation.
You are this close; are you not hot?
I drift over your head.
Can you tell where I am?

lines.zh: 我身上没有可以打的地方
lines.en: There is nothing on me to hit.
Can your weapon touch fire?
I yield half a step; my fire does not.
I light up your face.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道被烤出来了
lines.en: The heat draws out your smell.
I will not burn you unprovoked.
Walk away and I will dim.
Sparks drift from me toward you.

lines.zh: 我围着你转了整整一圈
lines.en: I circle you a full turn.
There is a scorch mark behind you.
I look down at you.
My fire is pressed smaller.
I scatter and re-form.

lines.zh: 我的火苗被压得偏向一边。
lines.en: My flame is pressed over to one side.
Sparks fly far.
I dim for an instant.
I feel no pain, only the shake.
A piece of my edge is gone.
I steady my flames.
My fire is still burning.
That will not scatter me.
Fire does not eat.

lines.zh: 你把那东西举起来做什么
lines.en: Why are you holding that up?
I would only burn it.
Hold it further away.

lines.zh: 这东西对我来说是燃料，不是食物
lines.en: That is fuel to me, not food.

lines.zh: 你手里那点木头不够烧。
lines.en: That bit of wood in your hand will not burn long.
When I near it, it scorches.
You may keep it.
I have no interest in that.
Do not hold it into the fire.
You walked through my flame.

lines.zh: 我散成火星，转眼又合拢。
lines.en: I scatter into sparks and close again at once.
My flame bends.
Do not walk against my flames.
Your sleeve is singed.
I have no body to bruise.

lines.zh: 我退开一点，热度就降了
lines.en: I pull back, and the heat drops.
Sparks fall all over you.
You stepped into my edge.
I rise a little.
Fire does not build a home.
I was summoned.
I never form such thoughts.
I am only a flame.
There is no need to ask.
I drift to the other side.
I have no need of a companion.
When I am done burning, I scatter.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，火也跟着晃
lines.en: I shake my head, and the fire shakes.
My flames have dimmed a little.
I cannot pick anything up.
It scorches the moment I touch it.
I cradle it in flame.
It turns to ash in my hold.
This is of no use whatever.
I burn it to ash.
I lift it, then let it drop.
Whose it is, I do not ask.
It burns at my feet.
I drift it along with flame.
You are standing in my light.
I begin gathering my flame.
My light is locked on you.
I know the heat of you.
The fire already leans your way.

lines.zh: 隔这么远，我照样烧得到。
lines.en: From this far off I can still burn you.
My edge has brightened.
Run, and my fire arrives before you.
I am guessing where you will dodge.
This will come from above.
I rise a little higher.
I am ready on this side.
All my fire leans toward you.
There is a wall at your back.
I drift above you.

lines.zh: 我在找能烧到你的角度
lines.en: I am finding an angle that reaches you.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，火就从下面来
lines.en: Block high, and the fire comes low.
My flame keeps gathering.
I am not hurried; fire waits.
You are driven up against the wall.
Sparks circle me.

lines.zh: 你听见嘶嘶的声音了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the hissing?
The heat is still climbing.
My shape has changed.
You are starting to sweat.
I edge closer.
I wait for you to raise a hand.
I have heated this ground.
Only the last blow remains.
I spit a ball of flame.
The fire bursts at your feet.
You jumped aside.
My tongue of flame catches you.
The air warps with the heat.

lines.zh: 你身上的水汽一下蒸干了
lines.en: The moisture on you flashes to steam.
I gather another.
This time there is no dodging.
A black mark burns into the floor.
You retreat; I have not moved.
A flame rises out of the brazier.
The stone room brightens.
The sigil under me is still hot.
I gather into shape from sparks.
The air begins to scorch.
I hover above head height.
My skirt of flame spreads.

lines.zh: 这里的石墙借我照一照
lines.en: Let these walls borrow my light.
I turn once, slowly.
Someone is near.
I draw my fire in a little.
I take this corner.

lines.zh: 我身上的火在石墙上跳
lines.en: My fire dances on the stone walls.
I hold my heat as low as I can.
Fire on fire only stirs me.
Water drags me down.

lines.zh: 水汽把我压得几乎散了
lines.en: The steam nearly smothers me out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹得四分五裂
lines.en: The blast scatters me apart.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，留下一个洞
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a hole.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的火拧成一团
lines.en: Magic twists my flame into a knot.
I have burned long; there is little left.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，火一下暴起
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my fire surges.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有可以烧的东西
lines.en: There is nothing in the void to burn.
